proposal.expected_reason: CP-SAT at max_seconds=1 will return a verified complete-batch Makespan strictly below 74.0 s on F_competition, or an OPTIMAL status at a value at or below 74.0 s, showing the bottleneck rule is not optimal.
proposal.selection_reason: Round-001 gives a verified rule incumbent of 74.0 s on F_competition but no optimality evidence. The smallest allowed CP-SAT budget (1 s) is the cheapest informative probe to test whether the bottleneck rule is near-optimal or whether exact search can improve it, and it begins mapping the CP-SAT budget/quality curve before larger budgets are spent. F_competition has a single dominant bottleneck (RINSE nominal load 28.0 s), a favorable structure for exact search.
